mapper.select: /* 정산: 행 잠금 조회 (상태 전이 검증용) */ SELECT STLM_SN AS stlmSn, TRD_SN AS trdSn, USR_SN AS usrSn, STLM_AMT AS stlmAmt, STLM_STATUS_CD AS stlmStatusCd, STLM_REG_DT AS stlmRegDt, STLM_UPDT_DT AS stlmUpdtDt FROM SETTLEMENT WHERE STLM_SN = #{stlmSn} FOR UPDATE

/* 정산: 거래번호 기준 단건 조회 */ SELECT STLM_SN AS stlmSn, TRD_SN AS trdSn, USR_SN AS usrSn, STLM_AMT AS stlmAmt, STLM_STATUS_CD AS stlmStatusCd, STLM_REG_DT AS stlmRegDt, STLM_UPDT_DT AS stlmUpdtDt FROM SETTLEMENT WHERE TRD_SN = #{trdSn}

/* 정산: 거래번호 기준 잠금 조회 */ SELECT STLM_SN AS stlmSn, TRD_SN AS trdSn, USR_SN AS usrSn, STLM_AMT AS stlmAmt, STLM_STATUS_CD AS stlmStatusCd, STLM_REG_DT AS stlmRegDt, STLM_UPDT_DT AS stlmUpdtDt FROM SETTLEMENT WHERE TRD_SN = #{trdSn} FOR UPDATE

SELECT settlement.TRD_SN AS tradeId, settlement.STLM_SN AS settlementId, settlement.STLM_STATUS_CD AS statusCode, statusCode.CMM_NM AS statusName FROM SETTLEMENT settlement LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE statusCode ON statusCode.CMM_CD = settlement.STLM_STATUS_CD WHERE settlement.TRD_SN IN
#{tradeId}

/* 정산: 회원별 목록 (최신순 100건) */ SELECT STLM_SN AS stlmSn, TRD_SN AS trdSn, USR_SN AS usrSn, STLM_AMT AS stlmAmt, STLM_STATUS_CD AS stlmStatusCd, STLM_REG_DT AS stlmRegDt, STLM_UPDT_DT AS stlmUpdtDt FROM SETTLEMENT WHERE USR_SN = #{usrSn} ORDER BY STLM_SN DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.sql: S.STLM_SN AS settlementId, S.TRD_SN AS tradeId, S.USR_SN AS userId, U.USR_NM AS userName, S.STLM_AMT AS amount, S.STLM_STATUS_CD AS statusCode, SC.CMM_NM AS statusName, S.STLM_REG_DT AS registeredAt, S.STLM_UPDT_DT AS updatedAt, A.STLM_ADM_ACT_TYPE AS lastActionType, A.STLM_ADM_ACT_RSN_CN AS processReason, A.STLM_PROC_USR_SN AS processorUserId, PU.USR_NM AS processorName, A.STLM_ADM_ACT_REG_DT AS processedAt

FROM SETTLEMENT S JOIN USERS U ON U.USR_SN = S.USR_SN LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE SC ON SC.CMM_CD = S.STLM_STATUS_CD LEFT JOIN SETTLEMENT_ADMIN_ACTION A ON A.STLM_ADM_ACT_SN = ( SELECT MAX(LA.STLM_ADM_ACT_SN) FROM SETTLEMENT_ADMIN_ACTION LA WHERE LA.STLM_SN = S.STLM_SN ) LEFT JOIN USERS PU ON PU.USR_SN = A.STLM_PROC_USR_SN

where.if: AND ( CAST(S.STLM_SN AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(S.TRD_SN AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(S.USR_SN AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR U.USR_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT STLM_ADM_ACT_SN AS actionSn, STLM_SN AS settlementSn, STLM_ADM_ACT_TYPE AS actionType, STLM_PREV_STATUS_CD AS previousStatusCode, STLM_NEXT_STATUS_CD AS nextStatusCode, STLM_ADM_ACT_RSN_CN AS reason, STLM_ADM_REQ_ID AS requestId, STLM_PROC_USR_SN AS processorUserSn, STLM_ADM_ACT_REG_DT AS processedAt FROM SETTLEMENT_ADMIN_ACTION WHERE STLM_ADM_REQ_ID = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SETTLEMENT_ADMIN_ACTION ( STLM_SN, STLM_ADM_ACT_TYPE, STLM_PREV_STATUS_CD, STLM_NEXT_STATUS_CD, STLM_ADM_ACT_RSN_CN, STLM_ADM_REQ_ID, STLM_PROC_USR_SN ) VALUES ( #{settlementSn}, #{actionType}, #{previousStatusCode}, #{nextStatusCode}, #{reason}, #{requestId}, #{processorUserSn} )
